description: Limited Base contract bytecode, EIP-1967 slot and zero-supply heuristics. Missing or unsupported property reads are null; RPC transport failures return 502. Ownership renunciation requires a confirmed zero owner. Empty slots do not identify uninitialized proxies. EOAs return not-applicable. Not a full security audit; see endpoint details for coverage limits. Use before approving or calling an unfamiliar Base contract. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: contract-risk
